result.reason: The new language includes the preferred frequency, notice, business-hours, confidentiality, and cost-allocation protections, but it does not prohibit direct access to Licensee systems. It also leaves the original broad audit provision intact, creating overlap and potential conflict regarding auditor qualifications, scope, and timing. The added 24-month look-back, contingent-fee restriction, and overpayment-with-interest remedy go beyond the stated playbook, while limiting the audit to fee-relevant records changes the original right to audit compliance with all agreement terms. The duplicated, inconsistent operative language is not professionally integrated.
